limitations: No rigging, deformation, collision, physical scale or Godot integration certification

CH01.note: Flat close-fitting back; no separate backpack

CH02.note: Integrated upper suit panel only; no protruding backpack

review_limitations: Four accepted LOD1 are distant-view candidates, not close-up or game-ready certifications.
All LOD2 withheld because seam protection makes them duplicate LOD1 budgets.
TL01 stays base-only for negligible savings; TL02/TL03 stay base-only for visual defects.
Base tool meshes already contain about 1.8-2.1k triangles.
Normals/UV interpolation can change local shading even when source image pixels and PBR roles are preserved.
Triangle reduction does not imply fewer materials/draw calls or smaller texture/file memory.
No additional Blender iterations; no automatic character repairs; no rig/collision invented.
